'''2003 Mystic Visions''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament in Columbia, Pennsylvania (3 May 2003). It was the Mystic Visions Open, a Players Committee Open Qualifier directed by [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]]; [[Jon Westergard]] and [[Brandon Pahl]] qualified for Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-events03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031209110207/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2003 Events], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 9 December 2003.</ref>
